verses.text: Ach in Diosal, ak' a tojolal yet' a wach' pensaril t'a winh rey tik, haton yuninal winh rey sik'b'ilel uuj,
yik wach' t'a stojolal yet' t'a swach'ilal syak' yajalil winh t'a a chonhab' yet' t'a heb' meb'a'.
Yuj chi', ol aj junk'olal yet' tojolal t'a skal heb' a chonhab' kajan t'a jolomtak witz yet' t'a tzalkixtak.
Tojol ol yutok winh rey tik sb'oan yaj t'a heb' meb'a'. Ol koljok heb' ayoch t'a yalanh mheb'ail yuj winh. Haxo heb' ixtum anima, ol ak'jok syaelal heb' yuj winh.
Yak'okab'em sb'a heb' a chonhab' t'ayach, yakb'an ayto ek' k'u yet' k'een uj t'a masanil tiempo.
Yak'okab' swach'k'olal winh rey icha nhab', ma icha yal ak'wal tz'ak'anoch yaal lum lum yet' anh ank'ultak.
Ayokab' wach'ilal yet' tojolal t'a yol stiempoal winh, masanto ol satel k'een uj.
Yak'okab' yajalil winh t'a yib'anh masanil, schael yich t'a sti' ha' mar, masanto t'a sti' junxo ha' mar chi'. T'a sti' ha' niwan Éufrates, masanto b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik.
Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a winh, haton heb' kajan t'a tzinan lu'um, yak'okab'em sb'a heb' t'a winh t'a emnakilal masanto tz'emk'och tenan sti' heb' t'a sat lu'um.
Masanil heb' winh sreyal juntzanh chonhab', haton Tarsis, juntzanh ay t'a stitak ha' mar, Sabá yet' Seba, yak'okab' silab' heb' yet' yalkabar t'a winh.
Emokab' kuman heb' rey smasanil t'a winh. Ak'jokab' serwil winh yuj masanil nación.
Yujto a winh ol kolanel heb' meb'a' syal sb'a t'ay, haton heb' ayoch t'a tzapan majanil malaj mach skolani.
Ol ok' sk'ol winh yuj heb' meb'a' ilb'aj k'ool. Ol koljokel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' chamel yuj winh.
Ol koljokel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ixtum anima yet' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' komonnhej sb'at t'a yib'anh heb' yetanimail, yujto niwan yelk'och sk'inal heb' meb'a' chi' t'a yichanh winh.
Aynhejokab' sk'inal winh rey chi'. Ak'jokab' k'een oro yik Sabá t'a winh. k'anjokab' sk'inal winh t'a Dios. Alchajnhejokab' wach' lolonel t'a winh.

Te wach'okab' tz'aj ixim trigo t'a sat lum ko lu'um tik. Yak'okab' ixim t'a jolomtak witz. K'ib'okab' ixim trigo icha tz'aj sk'ib' te te' t'a Líbano. K'ib'okab' sb'isul anima t'a ko chonhab' tik icha anh ank'ultak t'a sat lu'um.
Nachajokab'kot winh rey t'a masanil tiempo. Aynhejokab' sb'inajnakil winh icha k'u. Masanilokab' nación schaan wach'ilal yuj winh. Yalokab' heb' to te wach' yik winh.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová Dios, haton ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik. Anhej syal sk'ulan juntzanh tas sat ko k'ool kilani.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ay t'a masanil tiempo. Ojtakajokab'el sb'inajnakil t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Yik'okab' icha chi'.
Haton t'a tik ix lajwikan slesal winhaj David, yuninal winhaj Isaí.
